chunks.expectedText:
Chapter one: At the Gate

The stranger paused at the edge of the gate as the mist clung to the cobblestones, concealing a village of black spires that pierced the twilight sky with silent, watchful eyes.
chunks.transcription: CHAPTER I At the gate, the stranger paused at the edge of the gate, as the mist clung to the cobblestones, concealing a village of black spires that pierced the twilight sky with silent, watchful eyes.
